source.label: Synthesised test signals, not a recording
source.note: A plucked-string model, a sung-vowel model and cassette-style noise, all made in code. They show that the method and the measurement work; they do not show how it sounds on a real oud.

separation.method: semi-supervised NMF, 60 oud bases learned from another piece, 16 free bases

clips.label: Extracted oud
clips.what: What the method kept as oud

clips.label: Extracted voice
clips.what: Everything it did not explain as oud

clips.label: Remix
clips.what: The extracted oud with the voice turned down 12 dB

restoration.method: spectral subtraction, alpha 2.0, at most 18.0 dB

clips.label: Noisy
clips.what: The clean take with tape noise added at a known level

clips.label: Clean
clips.what: The take before any noise was added
